frame.process: Define the economy's money holdings at an instant.
frame.how: Transfer ₹100 between two holders, then distinguish the unchanged stock from payments.
frame.when: Measure at one selected instant, not across a month.
frame.conditions: Specify eligible monetary components and avoid repeated counting.
frame.atmosphere: A buyer pays a neighbourhood kirana shop.

frame.process: Organize the five aggregate names by coverage.
frame.how: Keep M0 separate; branch M2 and M3 from M1 and extend M3 to M4.
frame.when: Overview precedes detailed formulas.
frame.conditions: Overlapping aggregates must not be added together.
frame.atmosphere: A household and shop hold cash and several kinds of deposits.

frame.process: Read and qualify the five-tier money pyramid.
frame.how: Scan apex to base, then replace misleading cumulative implications with component baskets.
frame.when: After the family overview and before detailed mechanisms.
frame.conditions: Printed abbreviations are not complete definitions.
frame.atmosphere: Five widening tiers beside an accurate branch diagram.

frame.process: Money moves through payments and deposits.
frame.how: Follow a household payment to a shop and its bank, with a separate bank–RBI link.
frame.when: During purchases, wages, deposits and lending.
frame.conditions: A payment generally transfers money; every household payment need not directly involve RBI.
frame.atmosphere: A local shop connected to the banking system.

frame.process: Identify directly RBI-created reserve money.
frame.how: An RBI security purchase credits a bank's reserve account.
frame.when: Central-bank money provides a base for subsequent banking activity.
frame.conditions: Reserves support settlement and potential lending, not compulsory lending.
frame.atmosphere: RBI and a commercial bank's reserve account.

frame.process: Construct M0 from three monetary stocks.
frame.how: Distinguish circulating currency, other RBI deposits and bankers' RBI deposits.
frame.when: Use balances for the same instant.
frame.conditions: Use common units; include bank vault cash and CRR balances without double counting.
frame.atmosphere: Public wallets, a bank vault and accounts held at RBI.

frame.process: Bank lending creates deposit money across the banking system.
frame.how: An ₹80 loan and a subsequent ₹60 loan create ₹140 of deposits under stated assumptions.
frame.when: Lending and interbank settlement occur in successive rounds.
frame.conditions: Reserves, capital, liquidity, lending standards and credit demand constrain expansion.
frame.atmosphere: Two banks, a business borrower and a supplier.

frame.process: Define M1 through near-immediate spendability.
frame.how: Demonstrate a cash purchase and a demand-account payment before explaining Narrow Money.
frame.when: Funds are needed for everyday transactions.
frame.conditions: Almost immediate use does not mean every form of savings qualifies.
frame.atmosphere: A customer paying for groceries.

frame.process: Build M1 and M2 component by component.
frame.how: Add public currency, demand deposits and other RBI deposits; then add eligible post-office savings deposits.
frame.when: Compare updated balances after completed transfers.
frame.conditions: Exclude bank vault cash from public currency and NSC from the M2 addition.
frame.atmosphere: Wallet, bank account and post-office passbook.

frame.process: Classify post-office products as included or excluded in the M2 addition.
frame.how: Separate savings-bank deposits from NSC and similar instruments.
frame.when: Before adding post-office holdings to M1.
frame.conditions: Product type, not the institution alone, determines inclusion.
frame.atmosphere: Two different savings products offered at a post office.

frame.process: Compare liquidity and convenience of savings deposits.
frame.how: Contrast availability of funds with ease of accessing or using them.
frame.when: A saver needs money for a payment.
frame.conditions: Relative inconvenience does not imply inaccessibility; no current restrictions are assumed.
frame.atmosphere: A saver comparing bank and post-office account access.

frame.process: Construct M3 and M4 and distinguish importance from breadth.
frame.how: Add bank time deposits to M1, then qualifying post-office deposits to M3.
frame.when: Use same-date stocks; reset assumptions for separate worked examples.
frame.conditions: M3 does not start from M2; M4 excludes NSC and counts post-office savings once.
frame.atmosphere: A bank FD conversion, a monetary-statistics desk and a news headline.

frame.process: Explain RBI monitoring and the NSC exclusion.
frame.how: Trace loan-created deposits into monetary indicators, then contrast spendable cash with a long-term certificate.
frame.when: Policy analysis compares monetary growth with credit, output and prices.
frame.conditions: M3 is an indicator, not proof of inflation; specific exclusions do not exclude all term deposits.
frame.atmosphere: A local business loan and a family's long-term savings decision.

beats.say: Cash, bank balance और FD—क्या हमेशा सब जोड़ेंगे?
beats.on_screen: Wallet, bank balance and FD; question mark over total.

beats.say: खरीदार के ₹100, दुकानदार के ₹0 हैं। खरीदारी के बाद दोनों के balances उलट गए, लेकिन combined cash ₹100 ही रहा।
beats.on_screen: Buyer ₹100 → ₹0; shopkeeper ₹0 → ₹100; total unchanged.

beats.say: Money supply economy में एक तय पल पर spending, saving और payments के लिए उपलब्ध money है। Holdings की photo सोचो; यह stock है।
beats.on_screen: Freeze economy-wide holdings at one instant.

beats.say: महीने के payments का total यह stock नहीं है। वही ₹100 बार-बार इस्तेमाल हो सकता है।
beats.on_screen: Repeated payments with one ₹100 note versus one snapshot.

beats.say: यानी तय पल की holdings गिनेंगे। Cash और deposits इस्तेमाल करने की आसानी अलग है, इसलिए अलग measures चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Snapshot plus component boundary.

beats.say: Bank के RBI account में ₹100 हैं। RBI उससे ₹100 की security खरीदकर account में जोड़ता है; अब ₹200 हैं। यह बढ़ा balance payments का आधार बनेगा।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical security purchase; reserve balance ₹100 → ₹200. Delay aggregate names.

beats.say: ₹2000 में से ₹1000 का certificate खरीदो। किराने के लिए ₹1000 cash बचा; certificate नहीं दोगे। यह भविष्य की बचत National Savings Certificate, यानी NSC है।
beats.on_screen: Cash ₹2000 → ₹1000; certificate ₹0 → ₹1000. Reveal name after the purchase.

beats.say: Hypothetical holdings लो: cash ₹1000, demand account ₹4000, bank time deposit ₹6000, Post Office savings ₹2000 और दूसरे eligible deposits ₹3000 हैं। Other RBI deposits zero मानो।
beats.on_screen: Holdings cards; separate ₹5000 NSC holding outside the eligible baskets. No aggregate labels yet.

beats.say: Cash और demand account के ₹5000 हुए। Post Office savings जोड़कर ₹7000 मिलेंगे। इसके बजाय ₹5000 में bank time deposit जोड़ो: ₹11000 मिलेंगे; eligible Post Office deposits भी जोड़ो तो ₹16000 होंगे।
beats.on_screen: Four unlabelled component baskets: ₹5000, ₹7000, ₹11000, ₹16000; NSC excluded.

beats.say: Demand account से ₹1000 तय समय वाली deposit में रखो। अब उनमें ₹3000 और ₹7000 हैं। पहले totals ₹4000 और ₹6000 होंगे; दोनों bank balances वाले totals ₹11000 और ₹16000 ही रहेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Move ₹1000 between deposit columns. Recalculate all four unlabelled totals.

beats.say: ये M1, M2, M3 और M4 हैं। M3 Broad Money, M4 broadest है; RBI-created base M0, Reserve Money है। याद रखो: M2 और M3, M1 से निकलने वाली branches हैं; overlapping totals मत जोड़ना।
beats.on_screen: Reveal names; M0 separate, M2 and M3 branch from M1, M4 extends M3. M3 is the principal reporting measure.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: Pyramid नीचे चौड़ा होता दिख रहा है? इसकी 5 tiers M0 से M4 तक cash और deposits की coverage पहचानने में मदद करती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Five widening tiers, apex to base; retain all component labels and no arrows.

beats.say: ऊपर से पढ़ो: M0, फिर M1 में Cash + Demand Deposits। अगले खाने में M2 के साथ PO savings हैं; PO यानी Post Office, जहाँ savings passbook रखते हो।
beats.on_screen: Reading path: apex M0 → M1 Cash + Demand Deposits → M2 + PO Savings Deposits. Show PO passbook image.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: फिर M3 पर Bank Time Deposits, जैसे FD दिखती है। सबसे नीचे M4 पर All PO Deposits except NSC है; savings certificate की पर्ची बाहर रखो।
beats.on_screen: Continue reading path through M3 and M4. FD receipt beside bank time deposits; NSC outside the qualifying PO deposit basket.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: अलग टोकरियाँ सोचो: M0 अलग रखो। M3 के लिए M1 वाली टोकरी में bank time deposits डालो, M2 वाली में नहीं। पूरी M1 टोकरी में OD भी आता है।
beats.on_screen: Replace the cumulative ladder with baskets. Show M1 + bank time deposits = M3; include OD within M1.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: याद रखो: tiers labels पहचानने के लिए हैं; जोड़ने के लिए सही component baskets इस्तेमाल करो।
beats.on_screen: Pyramid beside corrected component baskets; M0 separate, M2 and M3 branching from M1.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: किराने पर दिए ₹500 कहाँ गए? पहले दुकानदार को इस sale से ₹0 मिले थे; अब ₹500 मिले, जो उसने bank में जमा किए।
beats.on_screen: ₹500 household payment followed by shop deposit.

beats.say: यह money circulation है, यानी दुकान पर दिया पैसा आगे चलता है। Households, businesses और banks जुड़े हैं; banks का RBI से connection है।
beats.on_screen: Follow the shop payment into its bank; show a separate bank–RBI connection.

beats.say: Purchases, wages, deposits और loans पर पैसे चलते हैं। RBI transactions banks को जोड़ते हैं; हर खरीदारी सीधे RBI से नहीं गुजरती।
beats.on_screen: Animate payment paths and separate RBI transactions.

beats.say: Recipient अगला payment रोक दे तो आगे movement रुकेगा। पैसा गायब नहीं हुआ; अभी उसके पास है।
beats.on_screen: Pause next payment; balance stays with recipient.

beats.say: फिर देखो: खरीदार ने दिया, दुकानदार ने bank में जमा किया।
beats.on_screen: Replay purchase and bank deposit.

beats.say: Circulation movement है; Money supply तय पल की holdings है। पैसा चलना हमेशा नया पैसा बनना नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Flow versus stock.

beats.say: Bank का RBI balance ₹200 कैसे हुआ? पहले ₹100 थे; security खरीदकर RBI ने ₹100 जोड़े थे।
beats.on_screen: Replay the ₹100 purchase and resulting ₹200 reserve balance.

beats.say: सीधे RBI-created base M0 है: Reserve Money या High-Powered Money। Foundation की तरह यह आगे lending से bank money बनने का आधार है।
beats.on_screen: M0 foundation supports additional bank money.

beats.say: तुम्हारा deposit और bank का RBI balance अलग claims हैं। RBI balance withdrawals और banks के बीच settlement सँभालने में मदद करता है।
beats.on_screen: Customer → commercial bank claim; commercial bank → RBI claim. Attribution: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1.
beats.source: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1

beats.say: M0 आधार है। उससे आगे bank lending की गुंजाइश बनती है, lending अपने-आप नहीं होती।
beats.on_screen: Base supports, but does not compel, lending. Attribution: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, 2014 Q1.
beats.source: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1

beats.say: Public cash ₹1000, vault cash ₹200 और bank का RBI balance ₹800 हो तो कितना base पैसा है? Other RBI deposits zero मानकर total ₹2000 है।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical monetary-base holdings: ₹1000 + ₹200 + ₹800 = ₹2000; no formula labels yet.

beats.say: Bank RBI account से ₹100 के notes लेता है। Vault cash ₹300 और RBI balance ₹700 हो जाता है। M0 ₹2000 रहता है; public cash नहीं बढ़ता।
beats.on_screen: Currency in circulation ₹1200 → ₹1300; bankers' RBI deposits ₹800 → ₹700; M0 unchanged at ₹2000.

beats.say: C में public और bank cash हैं। Bankers' Deposits में CRR balances भी हैं; Cash Reserve Ratio यानी relevant liabilities का तय हिस्सा bank RBI में रखता है।
beats.on_screen: C = Currency in circulation: public currency + bank cash. Bankers' Deposits include CRR balances.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24; RBI, Master Direction—Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) Directions, 2021

beats.say: Account किसका, कहाँ? Bank का RBI account Bankers' Deposits है; eligible दूसरे RBI deposits OD हैं। तुम्हारा commercial-bank account OD नहीं: वह RBI में नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Holder–institution–category table. Do not classify every non-bank RBI account automatically as OD.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, reserve money components

beats.say: M0 = C + OD + Bankers' Deposits। एक ही date और unit के balances जोड़ो; customer के commercial-bank deposits इसमें मत डालना।
beats.on_screen: Three component boxes; same date and monetary unit. Attribution: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, reserve money components

beats.say: Loan से balance कैसे बढ़ता है? सारी ज़रूरी शर्तें पूरी मानो: Bank A ₹80 loan deposit बनाता है; borrower Bank B के supplier को देता है।
beats.on_screen: ₹80 loan creates deposit; supplier receives payment at Bank B.

beats.say: Bank B शर्तें पूरी करके ₹60 का दूसरा loan देता है। पहले इन loans के deposits नहीं थे; repayments और cash leakage छोड़ें तो अब ₹140 बने हैं।
beats.on_screen: Two illustrated loans create ₹80 + ₹60 = ₹140 of deposits.

beats.say: यह reserves-supported deposit expansion है। Loan deposit बनाता है; दूसरे bank को payment जाने पर settlement के लिए reserves चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Separate deposit creation from reserve settlement. Attribution: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, 2014 Q1.
beats.source: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1

beats.say: Supplier रकम account में रखता है तो deposit banking system में रहता है।
beats.on_screen: Follow the illustrative supplier receipt into its bank account. Attribution: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, 2014 Q1.
beats.source: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1

beats.say: Expansion guaranteed नहीं है। Withdrawals, liquidity और capital needs, lending standards तथा loan demand इसे सीमित करते हैं; reserves मिलना unlimited lending की छूट नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Constraints gate further lending. Attribution: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, 2014 Q1.
beats.source: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1

beats.say: Loan deposit बनाता है; payment settle होता है। आगे lending शर्तों पर निर्भर है, इसलिए expansion system-wide और conditional है।
beats.on_screen: Deposit creation → settlement → conditional further lending. Attribution: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, 2014 Q1.
beats.source: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy, Quarterly Bulletin, 2014 Q1

beats.say: ₹200 का किराना अभी चाहिए? ₹500 cash से दोगे तो ₹300 बचेंगे; ₹1000 payment-ready account से ₹300 दो तो ₹700 बचेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Two separate immediate-payment examples.

beats.say: यह immediate-payment focus M1, Narrow Money की पहचान है। यह public का सबसे liquid money है, यानी जल्दी इस्तेमाल होने वाला पैसा।
beats.on_screen: M1: most liquid; almost immediately spendable.

beats.say: FD में access की शर्तें हो सकती हैं। Narrow तुरंत इस्तेमाल वाले components हैं, पतले notes नहीं।
beats.on_screen: FD outside immediate-payment boundary.

beats.say: M1 almost immediately spendable components गिनता है। अब formula बनाओ।
beats.on_screen: Payment-ready components become formula cards.

beats.say: Cash ₹1000, demand balance ₹4000 और other RBI deposits zero हों तो ₹5000 हुए। Post Office savings ₹2000 भी गिनें तो ₹7000 होंगे; किस boundary में क्या आएगा?
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical contribution, not national totals. Calculate ₹5000 and ₹7000 before revealing aggregate labels.

beats.say: Wallet से ₹500 जमा करो। अब cash ₹500 और Post Office savings ₹2500 हैं। M1 में ₹4500 बचे; passbook जोड़कर ₹7000 हैं। यह M2, Intermediate Money है।
beats.on_screen: After settlement, move ₹500 from wallet to PO savings passbook. Show ₹4500 + ₹2500 = ₹7000, then reveal M2.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: Demand deposits में on-demand current और savings balances आते हैं। M1 में bank vault cash और Bankers' Deposits नहीं; OD दोनों formulas में है।
beats.on_screen: M0 versus M1 inclusion table.

beats.say: Original balances पर लौटो। Bank से ₹500 निकालो तो cash ₹1500, demand ₹3500: M1 ₹5000 रहा। Account की पुरानी रकम फिर जोड़ोगे तो double counting होगी।
beats.on_screen: Reset original cash ₹1000 and demand ₹4000; withdraw ₹500; sum updated balances only.

beats.say: M1 में public currency, Demand Deposits और OD जोड़ो। M2 में इसके ऊपर Post Office savings deposits जोड़ो; bank time deposits और NSC नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Build M1 and M2 formulas; excluded cards outside. Attribution: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: Post Office passbook और certificate दोनों जोड़ेंगे? M2 addition में savings-bank deposits included हैं; NSC और similar instruments excluded हैं।
beats.on_screen: Two-branch product classification.

beats.say: Savings deposit खाते की रकम है; NSC लंबे समय का certificate है। जगह एक, लेकिन product और access अलग हैं; गिनती भी अलग होगी।
beats.on_screen: Parallel product cards: account deposit versus long-term certificate; inclusion versus exclusion.
beats.source: Government of India, National Savings Certificates (VIII Issue) Scheme, 2019

beats.say: Deposit और certificate अलग हैं; Post Office नाम देखकर दोनों मत जोड़ना।
beats.on_screen: Deposit included; certificate excluded.

beats.say: Exam trick: M2 में eligible savings deposit है, हर savings product नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Read product type, not merely institution.

beats.say: दो accounts में ₹1000 हों तो ₹300 का bill देना बराबर आसान होगा? दोनों में रकम है; अब इस्तेमाल का रास्ता देखो।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical equal balances: ordinary bank deposit ₹1000 and PO savings ₹1000; grocery bill ₹300.

beats.say: मानो bank account से सीधे bill दो, पर चुने हुए Post Office access में पहले cash निकालो। रकम दोनों में है; दूसरे रास्ते में extra step है।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical paths only: direct account payment versus withdrawal then payment. Not a universal restriction.

beats.say: यह hypothetical है, universal restriction नहीं। रकम निकाल सकना liquidity है; payment के steps convenience बदलते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical access paths; availability versus access steps.

beats.say: Fairly liquid और slightly less convenient साथ हो सकते हैं। Less convenient का मतलब inaccessible नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Less convenient ≠ inaccessible.

beats.say: Post Office savings fairly liquid हैं, ordinary bank deposits से थोड़ी कम convenient; availability और access अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Comparison table: liquidity and relative convenience.

beats.say: Bank में ₹1000 तय समय के लिए रखो तो तुरंत खर्च करोगे? जल्दी निकालने की शर्तें हो सकती हैं। ये Time Deposits हैं; FD, recurring deposits और दूसरे bank time deposits M3 में आते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Agreed-term ₹1000 deposit; identify FD, RD and other bank time deposits.
beats.source: RBI, Master Direction—Reserve Bank of India (Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2016

beats.say: M1 ₹5000 में bank time deposits ₹6000 जोड़ो: ₹11000, यानी M3 या Broad Money। फिर Post Office savings ₹2000 और दूसरे eligible deposits ₹3000 जोड़ो: ₹16000, यानी M4; NSC बाहर है।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical contributions, OD zero. Calculate before revealing M3 and M4 labels; NSC card excluded. PO savings counted once.

beats.say: News में money-supply growth आम तौर पर M3 है। M4 broadest है: M3 plus eligible Post Office deposits, NSC नहीं। Recurring deposits में नियमित किस्तें जमा करते हो।
beats.on_screen: M3: most important and usual news reference. M4: broadest. Show its component formula and RD instalments.

beats.say: इसलिए सबसे बड़ा घेरा हमेशा सबसे important indicator नहीं है। M4 की coverage चौड़ी है; फिर भी news में M3 देखोगे। दोनों भी सारी wealth नहीं गिनते: NSC बाहर है।
beats.on_screen: Contrast coverage with reporting importance: M4 broadest; M3 principal news measure; excluded NSC remains outside monetary coverage.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: M3 में M1 और bank time deposits जोड़ो, M2 नहीं। M4 में M3 और eligible Post Office deposits जोड़ो; NSC बाहर है, savings को दोबारा मत जोड़ना।
beats.on_screen: Component formulas; count qualifying PO savings once. Attribution: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24.
beats.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24, monetary aggregates tables

beats.say: नया loan क्या बदलता है? पहले M3 में ₹1000 थे; bank ने ₹100 loan दिया, supplier ने रकम account में रखी। बाकी बदलाव न हों तो अब ₹1100 गिनेंगे।
beats.on_screen: New lending increases illustrative M3 by ₹100.

beats.say: Loan से बढ़े balances पर RBI नज़र रखता है। Certificate अलग है: वह भविष्य की बचत का डिब्बा समझो, आज किराने पर देने वाला wallet नहीं। इसलिए NSC, M4 से बाहर है।
beats.on_screen: Connect loan-created balances to monitoring; contrast future savings certificate with today's grocery wallet.

beats.say: M3 liquidity और credit conditions के संकेत देता है। अगर spending उपलब्ध सामान से तेज़ बढ़े तो दामों पर दबाव बन सकता है; इसलिए money growth को output और prices के साथ पढ़ेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Conditional links; compare monetary holdings, credit, output and prices. Attribution: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22.
beats.source: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22

beats.say: Policy effectiveness जाँचने के लिए देखेंगे: RBI के कदमों के बाद money, credit और prices चाही दिशा में गए या नहीं। M3 अकेला फैसला नहीं देता।
beats.on_screen: Assess money, credit and prices together after policy action.
beats.source: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22

beats.say: इसलिए M3 के साथ credit और price evidence देखो; Post Office product होने भर से NSC को शामिल मत करो।
beats.on_screen: Evidence dashboard and explicit NSC exclusion. Attribution: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22.
beats.source: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22

beats.say: M3 बढ़ना inflation का proof नहीं; यह loans का total भी नहीं। NSC बाहर है, लेकिन bank time deposits M3 में आते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Reject three confusions. Attribution: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22; Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24.
beats.source: RBI, Report on Currency and Finance, 2021–22; RBI, Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2023–24

beats.say: RBI के checks हैं inflationary pressures, liquidity, credit growth और policy effectiveness। NSC long-term, readily spendable नहीं; इसलिए M4 से बाहर है।
beats.on_screen: Four monitoring gauges; NSC exclusion chain.

beats.say: आखिरी check: किसका balance, कहाँ, कौन-सा product? इसी से सही aggregate चुनोगे।
beats.on_screen: Final holder–institution–product checklist beside the aggregate map: M0 separate; M2 and M3 branch from M1.
